Message.Name: Closing Price Message
Message.Description: The Closing Price message is generated near the end of the business day for each security. If the closing price is not available, ClosingPrice is set to 0. NumberOfTrades is not populated for SS (OMD Securities Standard) clients.

Field.Name: SecurityCode
Field.Description: Uniquely identifies a security available for trading.

Field.Name: ClosingPrice
Field.Description: Current Day Closing Price. 3 implied decimal places.

Field.Name: NumberOfTrades
Field.Description: Total Number of Trades performed on the given instrument.
